verdict.rationale: Starting an online filing without an account is a fair question for a government e-services portal, so the axis applies. Neither evidence item documents a keyless or file-number entry path. The root returns 200 but serves a script-only shell with 12 characters of readable text, and the long-published entry URL returns 404, so no published page describes how to begin without registering.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
